designReview: 无法完成专业设计复核：当前证据包只有 orchestrator、design_director、style_generator 的上游摘要，且 dispatchPlan 已在执行前阻断；未提供 CAD_PLAN、selectedStyleCandidate / styleCandidates 的具体几何参数、CAD readback、机器审计结果或截图。因此不能判断最终茶几符号是否像专业图纸、是否可读、比例是否合适、是否符合行业习惯，也不能声称 preview-only CAD 校验已完成。基于现有摘要，只能确认设计目的边界是“家具平面符号 / CAD preview-only 设计草图”，不是施工详图或系统资产沉淀。

learningCandidate.errorPattern: Design reviewer invoked before final CAD evidence existed; only upstream summaries were available and dispatch was blocked before execution.
learningCandidate.correctPattern: Run design review after CAD_PLAN, selected style candidate, validation/dry-run, CAD readback, machine audit, and visual acceptance evidence are attached.
